pluscuamperfecto.overview: El Pretérito Pluscuamperfecto (Past Perfect) expresa una acción pasada que ocurrió ANTES de otra acción pasada. Es el 'pasado del pasado' — establece una secuencia clara de dos eventos pasados.

construction.note: Uses the same irregular participles as the present perfect: dicho (decir), hecho (hacer), escrito (escribir), puesto (poner), visto (ver), vuelto (volver), roto (romper), muerto (morir), abierto (abrir) — the full list is in the Participios drill.

uses.name: Estructura 'Antes de' (Before-clause structure)
uses.description: ANTES DE + verbo infinitivo + Pretérito Pluscuamperfecto — describes what had already happened before another past action

examples.spanish: Luis, antes de ingresar a la clase, él había fumado una caja de 12 cigarrillos.
examples.english: Luis, before entering class, had smoked a pack of 12 cigarettes.
examples.explanation: The smoking (pluscuamperfecto) happened before entering class

examples.spanish: Los niños antes de almorzar habían rezado con la abuela.
examples.english: The children, before having lunch, had prayed with grandma.

examples.spanish: Antes de salir de casa, yo había apagado todas las luces.
examples.english: Before leaving the house, I had turned off all the lights.
examples.explanation: Turning off the lights (pluscuamperfecto) happened before leaving

examples.spanish: Ana, antes de dormir, había terminado su tarea.
examples.english: Ana, before going to sleep, had finished her homework.
examples.explanation: Finishing homework happened before going to sleep

examples.spanish: Antes de mudarme a España, yo había estudiado español durante dos años.
examples.english: Before moving to Spain, I had studied Spanish for two years.

examples.spanish: Antes de la fiesta, nosotros habíamos limpiado toda la casa.
examples.english: Before the party, we had cleaned the whole house.
examples.explanation: 'Antes de' + noun works too; the cleaning came first

examples.spanish: Antes de conocer a Marta, tú nunca habías bailado salsa.
examples.english: Before meeting Marta, you had never danced salsa.
examples.explanation: Nunca + pluscuamperfecto: no experience up to that earlier point

examples.spanish: Antes de cumplir treinta años, mi hermana ya había viajado a diez países.
examples.english: Before turning thirty, my sister had already traveled to ten countries.
examples.explanation: Ya + pluscuamperfecto: already completed before that moment

uses.name: Causa con Pluscuamperfecto (Cause using pluperfect)
uses.description: PRET. INDEFINIDO/IMPERFECTO + PORQUE + PRET. PLUSCUAMPERFECTO — explains a past event/state by referencing an even earlier past action

examples.spanish: Miguel se desmayó en la ceremonia porque no había desayunado.
examples.english: Miguel fainted at the ceremony because he hadn't had breakfast.
examples.explanation: Preterite (se desmayó) = result; Pluperfect (había desayunado) = earlier cause

examples.spanish: El niño estaba feliz porque había ganado el premio mayor.
examples.english: The child was happy because he had won the grand prize.
examples.explanation: Imperfect (estaba) = ongoing state; Pluperfect (había ganado) = earlier cause

examples.spanish: El niño había ganado el premio mayor, por eso estaba feliz.
examples.english: The child had won the grand prize, that's why he was happy.
examples.explanation: Reversed order: Pluperfect cause stated first, then 'por eso' (that's why) + imperfect result

examples.spanish: Nosotros llegamos tarde porque habíamos perdido el autobús.
examples.english: We arrived late because we had missed the bus.
examples.explanation: Preterite (llegamos) = result; Pluperfect (habíamos perdido) = earlier cause

examples.spanish: Ella no quiso comer porque ya había cenado.
examples.english: She didn't want to eat because she had already had dinner.
examples.explanation: Preterite (no quiso) = result; Pluperfect (había cenado) = earlier cause

examples.spanish: No pude entrar porque había olvidado las llaves.
examples.english: I couldn't get in because I had forgotten the keys.
examples.explanation: Preterite (no pude) = result; Pluperfect (había olvidado) = earlier cause

examples.spanish: Estábamos cansados porque habíamos caminado todo el día.
examples.english: We were tired because we had walked all day.
examples.explanation: Imperfect (estábamos) = state; Pluperfect (habíamos caminado) = earlier cause

examples.spanish: Ellos no fueron al cine porque ya habían visto la película.
examples.english: They didn't go to the cinema because they had already seen the film.
examples.explanation: Preterite (no fueron) = result; Pluperfect (habían visto) = earlier cause

examples.spanish: El profesor se enfadó porque los alumnos no habían hecho los deberes.
examples.english: The teacher got angry because the students hadn't done their homework.
examples.explanation: Preterite (se enfadó) = result; Pluperfect (no habían hecho) = earlier cause

sequence_of_past_tenses.explanation: When narrating multiple past events, Spanish uses different tenses to show WHICH happened first

order.timing: Main past narrative — the 'main' past events

related_expressions.example: Los turistas acaban de salir para la playa.
related_expressions.example_english: The tourists have just left for the beach.
related_expressions.note: Present tense acabar de = immediate past; different from pluscuamperfecto
